description: This Java class 'DataSourcePopulator' initializes and populates an in-memory database with contact data, user credentials, and ACL (Access Control List) permissions for security testing purposes.

classes.name: DataSourcePopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a database with sample contact data, user credentials, and ACL permissions for testing security features.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes database tables, inserts sample data, and sets up ACL permissions and ownerships.

methods.name: setCreateEntities
methods.description: Sets the number of contact entities to create.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the DataSource for database connection.

methods.name: setMutableAclService
methods.description: Sets the ACL service used for managing ACL entries.

methods.name: setPlatformTransactionManager
methods.description: Sets the transaction manager for database transactions.

methods.name: getCreateEntities
methods.description: Returns the number of contact entities to create.

methods.name: changeOwner
methods.description: Changes the owner of a contact record in the ACL system.

methods.name: grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants specific permissions to a user for a contact record.

methods.name: selectPerson
methods.description: Selects a random person name from predefined lists.

methods.name: updateAclInTransaction
methods.description: Updates an ACL entry within a transaction.
